Wolcott A. Hokanson, Jr., Kappa '50, Vice Presi
dent for Administration and Finance at Bowdoin Col
lege, has long been active in the affairs of Psi Upsilon
Fraternity. Currently President of the Kappa (Bow
doin) Chapter, Brother Hokanson is a former chapter
treasurer. He served as vice chairman of the com

mittee in charge of arrangements for the 126th Inter
national Psi Upsilon Convention, held at Bowdoin in
September of 1968.
In addition to his duties as Bowdoin's Vice Presi

mester of the 1968-69 academic year as a Lecturer in
Economics.
A magna cum laude and Phi Beta Kappa graduate
of Bowdoin in the Class of 1950, Brother Hokanson
has been a member of his alma mater's staff since
1953, when be was appointed Assistant to the Bursar.
He became Bursar in 1959, was appointed Executive
Secretary in 1961, and was named to his present posi

was awarded an M.B.A. degree at Harvard Univer

sity. He was Administrative Assistant to the Comp

became Business Manager of Adelphi College. He
served in the latter position until returning to Bow
